metas.name: Storybots: Answer Time
metas.description: Similar to Ada Twist, Scientist, it explains complex science and world questions through catchy songs and animation.

metas.name: Wild Kratts
metas.description: Combines animal education with adventure, perfect for kids who enjoyed the exploration in The Magic School Bus.

metas.name: Octonauts
metas.description: Teaches marine biology and teamwork through undersea rescue missions in a way that appeals to fans of Special Agent Oso.

metas.name: Daniel Tiger's Neighborhood
metas.description: Focuses on social-emotional learning and gentle life lessons, much like Bluey and Doc McStuffins.

metas.name: Puffin Rock
metas.description: A beautiful, calm animated series about nature and family that fans of Clifford the Big Red Dog will appreciate.

metas.name: Tumble Leaf
metas.description: Uses stop-motion to teach basic physics and scientific discovery through play, similar to Curious George.

metas.name: Molly of Denali
metas.description: Follows a curious girl in Alaska and teaches kids how to use informational texts to solve problems.

metas.name: Sid the Science Kid
metas.description: Uses comedy and music to promote scientific inquiry and preschool-level experimentation.

metas.name: Elinor Wonders Why
metas.description: Encourages young viewers to follow their curiosity about the natural world using the scientific method.

metas.name: Blaze and the Monster Machines
metas.description: Introduces STEM concepts like trajectory and force, appealing to the math-loving audience of Numberblocks.

metas.name: Team Umizoomi
metas.description: Focuses heavily on mathematical concepts like patterns, shapes, and counting, much like Peg + Cat.

metas.name: Cyberchase
metas.description: An adventure-filled show that uses logic and math to defeat a digital villain, similar to WordGirl's format.

metas.name: Dinosaur Train
metas.description: Blends a love for trains and dinosaurs with paleontology and natural history facts.

metas.name: Ask the StoryBots
metas.description: Features colorful robots who go on field trips to answer big questions, similar to The Magic School Bus.

metas.name: Alma's Way
metas.description: Teaches critical thinking and self-awareness as the main character 'thinks through' her daily challenges.

metas.name: Work It Out Wombats!
metas.description: Introduces computational thinking and sequential problem-solving for a preschool audience.

metas.name: Rosie's Rules
metas.description: Focuses on social studies and how a community works through the eyes of a curious young girl.

metas.name: Ready Jet Go!
metas.description: Explores astronomy and space science with an alien neighbor who makes learning about the stars fun.

metas.name: Super Why!
metas.description: Interactive literacy adventures that help kids learn to read by changing the outcomes of classic stories.

metas.name: Arthur
metas.description: A long-running favorite that covers social situations, school life, and family relationships in a relatable way.

metas.name: Lyla in the Loop
metas.description: Focuses on creative problem-solving and strategic thinking within a supportive family setting.

metas.name: Go, Diego, Go!
metas.description: An educational adventure show that teaches kids about animal rescue and biological facts.

metas.name: Wonder Pets!
metas.description: Emphasizes teamwork and music appreciation as classroom pets rescue animals in trouble.

metas.name: Little Einsteins
metas.description: Introduces young children to classical music and world-famous art through interactive missions.

metas.name: Mister Rogers' Neighborhood
metas.description: The quintessential show for emotional intelligence and kindness, perfect for fans of Bluey's gentle nature.

metas.name: Sesame Street
metas.description: A foundational educational show that covers everything from the alphabet to emotional resilience.

metas.name: Pete the Cat
metas.description: Features musical stories about staying positive and navigating childhood with a 'cool' attitude.

metas.name: Trash Truck
metas.description: A sweet and imaginative show about friendship and discovery that resonates with Clifford fans.

metas.name: Spirit Rangers
metas.description: Celebrates Native American culture and nature while teaching environmental stewardship.

metas.name: Puppy Dog Pals
metas.description: High-energy adventures that focus on being helpful and solving problems as a team.

metas.name: Fancy Nancy
metas.description: Teaches vocabulary and self-expression through a girl who loves everything elegant and unique.

metas.name: Helpsters
metas.description: From the makers of Sesame Street, this show uses puppets to teach the basics of planning and logic.

metas.name: Brainchild
metas.description: Explains the science of your world with topics like germs, emotions, and the ocean for older kids.

metas.name: Xavier Riddle and the Secret Museum
metas.description: Travels back in time to meet historical figures, showing kids how to be heroes in their own lives.

metas.name: Nature Cat
metas.description: Encourages children to explore the outdoors and learn about natural sciences through humor.

metas.name: Zoboomafoo
metas.description: Introduces kids to wildlife and animal behavior through a mix of live-action and puppetry.

metas.name: Bread Barbershop
metas.description: A whimsical comedy that encourages creativity and artistic flair through bread-based transformations.

metas.name: Dino Dan
metas.description: Uses CGI to show a young boy learning about dinosaurs in a modern-day setting.

metas.name: Blue's Clues & You!
metas.description: An updated classic that promotes critical thinking and observational skills through interaction.
